gpu_identity_source: Historical authorized GPU UUID; no GPU query performed for this request. Verify identity and availability only after approval.
scope: One F queue from original common initial with fixed half-weight loss and fresh AdamW. Only final200 may produce60 full samples using frozen noise and unit CFG, paired with historical S1 controls. No new control training or sampling.
deadlines: t0 before GPU preflight; train deadline t0+600; shared sampling deadline min(sampling_start+3000,t0+3600). No transfer of unused training budget.
stop_policy: Stop on first timeout/OOM/nonfinite/identity/counter/software-check/write failure; preserve completed products, finite raw features and full200/600/60/240/48 ledgers. No retry, resume, warmup, GPU switch, CPU fallback or replacement samples.
previous_authorizations: Both previous F attempts and all historical authorizations are consumed; none covers this new attempt.

verification.environment_note: Only standard-library file/hash checks performed. Runtime environment and GPU readiness are checked inside the authorized bounded execution.

previous_attempt.failure: Selected GPU already has a compute process

earlier_attempts.specific_cause: Undetermined; original query stdout/stderr were not persisted.
